    status, data = handle_filter_users({'where': 'name == "Ada"'})
    assert status == 200
    assert len(data['users']) == 1
    
    status, data = handle_filter_users({'where': 'id > 1 and name == "Linus"'})
    assert status == 200
    
    status, data = handle_filter_users({'where': 'name =='})
    assert status == 400
    
    status, data = handle_filter_users({})
    assert status == 400
    
    # Check security - function call is not allowed
    status, data = handle_filter_users({'where': '__import__("os")'})
    assert status == 400
    print("All tests passed")

test()
